remarks_1999: Double entries Whitney Archive. Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature. . . . Infor. from Miss Bry (An Amer. Place), July 1949: on permanent loan to the National Gallery of Art, Washington from Georgia O'Keeffe as part of the Alfred Stieglitz Collection." Reproduced and titled *Cow's Skull with Red* in *Art Digest* (June 1946); *Time* (May 1946). (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Cow's Skull on Red

description: A bright white cow's skull with smooth white horns contrasts with a deep red background with a black stripe running through its center. Behind the horns, a tan, horizontal stripe spans the width of the background.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
